```yaml
name: Deploy Call Kent Audio Worker

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'packages/call-kent-audio-worker/**'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-call-kent-audio-worker.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'packages/call-kent-audio-worker/**'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-call-kent-audio-worker.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  deploy:
    name: Deploy Audio Worker
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: 'packages/call-kent-audio-worker/package-lock.json'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        working-directory: packages/call-kent-audio-worker
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build
        working-directory: packages/call-kent-audio-worker
        run: npm run build

      - name: Deploy to Cloudflare
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          workingDirectory: packages/call-kent-audio-worker
          command: deploy
          environment: production
```
